title: If You're a CoreWeave Stock Investor, You Need to Know This | CRWV Stock
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate walks through CoreWeave's Q3 results, which he calls very good news for shareholders, without giving an explicit buy or hold instruction. Pricing power is the headline: prices rose about 25% in July and another 10% later in the quarter, and are still rising in Q4; capacity is being allocated to short-term spot deals at over $40m per megawatt per year, nearly double the $20-25m on four-to-five-year contracts. Even older-generation hardware is appreciating: Hopper pricing rose 30-50% quarter over quarter, defying expectations that three-to-four-year-old chips would be obsolete. More than 130,000 GPUs come off contract in 2027 and about 170,000 in 2028, with a robust pipeline of customers competing for the capacity; at current prices the 2027 renewals alone would generate approaching $4bn of incremental annualised revenue with no additional capex, rising toward $10bn including 2028. The risk he flags is the spot strategy itself: reserving capacity for short-term pricing could leave CoreWeave exposed in about two years if supply and demand normalise, though slower data-centre construction would keep installed compute scarcer and pricing higher for longer. The stock rose over 25% on the day after results. Call: CRWV UNCERTAIN (no explicit stance; prior BUY, fair value ~$94, unchanged).
